comment: Blessed from the pinned engine, hand-checked to the dollar: one Schedule K-1 (Form 1065), item D checked, item G the limited-partner box, box 1 12,000 and a box 20 code Z qualified PTP amount of 12,000. Item G limited with participation unanswered makes the K-1 passive by the section 469(h)(2) presumption, so section 469(k) step 1 combines 12,000 with no carry-in to an overall GAIN of 12,000, nonpassive in Schedule E column (k) — total income 48,250 + 12,000 = 60,250 and AGI the same (no adjustments). Standard deduction 15,750, so taxable income before QBI is 44,500. Form 8995: line 6 = 12,000 (the code Z amount; no section 199A dividends), line 7 carryforward 0, line 8 = 12,000 (the zero floor is not reached), line 9 = 20% x 12,000 = 2,400; line 5 = 0 (no qualified trade or business), so line 10 = 2,400. THE CAP DOES NOT BIND: line 11 = 44,500, line 12 = 0 (no net capital gain or qualified dividends), line 13 = 44,500 and line 14 = 20% x 44,500 = 8,900, well above 2,400 — so line 15 = 2,400 and Form 1040 line 13 = 2,400. Taxable income 44,500 - 2,400 = 42,100; income tax 4,817 = tax table row 42,100-42,150, midpoint 42,125 (1,192.50 + 12% x 30,200 = 4,816.50, half-up); total tax 4,817 (box 14 is blank, so no self-employment tax); withholding 6,000, overpayment 1,183.
